mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the foundation for formal education on which subsequent levels are built."

The PTA is an organization which brings parents and teachers together in the interest of the students.

School budget is a financial plan through which educational goals are translated into reality (Mussazi, 1982).

The National Universities Commission (NUC) is a parastatal under the Federal Ministry of Education (FME).

Secondary Education is the education that children receive after primary education and before the tertiary education.

Facilities like halls are used by the community for social engagement. iv.

Teachers are responsible for finding ways to educate all children.
